name: Creative Portfolio & Digital Experience
tagline: Editorial, high-performance developer portfolio merging creative WebGL physics with strict TypeScript full-stack architecture.
description: Custom digital flagship portfolio pairing sub-60fps canvas animations, WebGL shaders, and 3D rigid-body kinematics with a resilient, decoupled Node.js/TypeScript micro-backend.
problem: Traditional developer portfolios often rely on static, uninspired component templates that fail to tangibly showcase advanced frontend rendering, creative shader craft, and secure full-stack backend integration.
solution: Architected an interactive, sci-fi-inspired experience featuring a 24px continuous coordinate grid, a WebGL curved cylinder stack, a real-time Rapier 3D physics ID badge, and a dedicated contact microservice with rate limiting and automated email dispatch[cite: 11, 12].
metrics_and_highlights: Orchestrated sub-60fps 3D canvas rendering using Three.js, React Three Fiber, Rapier Physics, and OGL.
Engineered a persistent 24px dark grid coordinate layout across all viewports with Lenis inertial pin-stacking.
Built a decoupled TypeScript contact microservice on Render running Express 5, Zod runtime validation, and Resend delivery.
Implemented defensive API security: IP rate limiting (5 req / 15 min), strict origin CORS whitelist, and 32kb payload caps.
Achieved production-grade accessibility and performance with prefers-reduced-motion hooks and immutable 1-year asset edge caching.

creative_frontend_and_3d_engine: Hero Spaceship Cockpit Viewport with hyperspace starfield simulation, telemetry HUD, and interactive particle canvas typography[cite: 12]
3D Curved Cylinder Tech Stack powered by OGL featuring idle auto-spin, scroll-momentum coupling, and touch/drag controls[cite: 12]
Interactive 3D identity badge built with React Three Fiber and Rapier Physics featuring spring kinematics, collision boundaries, and gravity[cite: 12]
Stay-in-place book-style project card pin stacking orchestrated via Lenis smooth scrolling[cite: 12]
GSAP-driven 3D text reveals, SVG bending marquees, and screen-blended dual-color glow cursor interpolation[cite: 12]
backend_microservice_and_security: Decoupled Node.js (v20+) and Express 5 API written in strict TypeScript (NodeNext resolution)
MongoDB Atlas inquiry persistence paired with asynchronous transactional email notifications via Resend API[cite: 11]
Multi-layer perimeter protection: Helmet HTTP headers, express-rate-limit, and payload memory exhaustion guards[cite: 11]
Automated test coverage implementing Vitest and Supertest across healthy and error-state pathways[cite: 11]
